description: Create an E2E acceptance testing project to organize browser tests for a web app. A project groups test scenarios (use cases), specific test steps (test cases), and replayable browser scripts (test scripts) for one application. Create a project first before generating or running any E2E tests. Pass organizationId to create it under an organization the caller belongs to; omit it for a personal project. Pass primaryResolution, compatibleResolutions and runStrategy to verify every test case at more than one viewport (e.g. desktop and phone); omit them for R_1920x1080 alone under primaryOnly.

compatibleResolutions.description: Compatible resolutions: further viewports every test case also runs at, one run each, as runStrategy says, e.g. ["R_0390x0844"]. Replaces the whole list; [] clears it. Requires primaryResolution (read the current one with muggle-remote-project-display-resolutions-get) and must not include it; duplicates are dropped.

organizationId.description: Organization (UUID) that owns the project; its runs are billed to that organization. Omit for a personal project. The caller must be an active member: list memberships with muggle-remote-organization-list.

primaryResolution.description: Primary resolution: the viewport every test case in the project is generated and run at first, e.g. "R_1920x1080". Passed without compatibleResolutions, it also clears the compatible resolutions. Omit both to keep the current resolutions; a new project defaults to R_1920x1080 alone.

runStrategy.description: Run strategy across the resolutions: primaryOnly runs the primary alone and reports the compatible resolutions as not run; primaryFirst runs the compatible resolutions only after the primary passes; allAtOnce runs every resolution at once. Omit to keep the current one; a project that never set one runs primaryOnly.

name: muggle-remote-project-create
